court: Court of Appeal of California, First Appellate District
statute_version_applicable: Cal. Civil Code §3294(b) (post-1987 version — employer liability limitation with managing agent requirement)
rule_established: Managing agent under §3294(b) means employee with substantial discretionary authority over decisions that determine corporate policy — not merely supervisory authority; ratification by managing agent = post-conduct knowing approval or acquiescence
verification_note: Cite with standard Westlaw or Lexis verification before use in filed documents
